''See also: [[Dreadgod cults Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Dreadgod]] cults are groups of followers associated with the [[Dreadgods]]. These organizations are viewed as enemies by most people and are characterized by their lawless and reckless behavior, specifically their tendency to prey upon actual [[sacred artists]]. The cultists typically originate from modest backgrounds and utilize [[hunger madra]], which provides them with an unconventional method for [[advancement]]. While this allows members to progress rapidly, it often results in limited long-term growth and carries inherent risks. Although they have not always been major competitors, recent developments have seen them secure multiple positions in certain arenas. Currently, they are considered a danger to any survivors of the [[Wandering Titan]], though they are not yet viewed as a massive threat. They are known to drift around the territories of powerful beings and have been observed expending energy without replenishment.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|As groups that compete in the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned tournament]], the [[Dreadgod]] cults are regarded as enemies to everyone. During [[Reigan Shen]]'s participation in the [[Uncrowned]], three [[Monarchs]] from these cults were selected to compete. The presence of [[sacred artists]] from the cults is later noted at [[Sky's Edge]], where they work to pin [[Fury]] and others down.}}
